key.name: move-workspace-left
key.summary: Move the workspace you are on one place to the left
key.description: Its windows and its name go with it, and it stops at the first place.

key.name: move-workspace-right
key.summary: Move the workspace you are on one place to the right
key.description: Its windows and its name go with it, and it stops at the last place.

key.name: auto-names
key.description: A workspace you have not named shows the name of the app with most windows on it, in a lighter type. A name you give it replaces that.
